caption: The drawing depicts two identical sculptural objects, each featuring a large frog and a smaller frog on an abstract base that suggests foliage or water. The objects are colored in shades of brown, green, and hints of bronze, giving them a metallic appearance. The large frog is perched on top of the form, its body elongated with prominent eyes and splayed limbs. The smaller frog is positioned below and to the side of the larger frog, partially integrated into the surface. Both objects are shown from different angles: one in a slightly elevated side view, and the other in a lower, more horizontal perspective. The objects are enclosed within a lightly drawn rectangular border, and the artist's signature "W.O. Fletcher" appears at the lower right within the border. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Toy Bank: Frog
